rule.change_our_mind: We would change the recommendation if at least 1 dated, sourced demand signals and 1 competitor with a verified public price were found, with no blocking compliance flag and a plan that fits the founder's budget and time.

definitions.demand_signal: A SUPPORTED claim, backed by a fetched source, of one of: a first-person problem statement with a date, on a site in community_domains (articles, template galleries and vendor blogs never count); an existing paid product with a public pricing page; a sourced trend whose quote contains a figure or date (at most one trend counts). Search-snippet claims are PARTIAL and never count.
definitions.paying_competitor: A competitor whose price was read from its own fetched page and verified by the claim checker.
definitions.direct_competitor: Same buyer, same job, same channel as the founder's idea.
definitions.blocking_compliance_flag: The idea falls in an excluded category (physical goods, financial/crypto, health or legal advice) or needs a licence the founder does not have.

rule.brief_idea: A pack of payment-reminder email templates and an invoicing checklist for new freelancers
rule.counting: distinct (source_url, type) SUPPORTED claims of types demand_signal, paying_competitor, trend, checked by a different model family
